:::{#def-weighted-sum}
#### Weighted sum, weights

A **weighted sum** of the numbers $a_1, \ldots, a_k$
is a [linear combination](#def-linear-combination) of them,
and its coefficients $w_1, \ldots, w_k$ are called its **weights**:

$$w_1 a_1 + \cdots + w_k a_k = \sumto{i}{k} w_i a_i$$

Each number $a_i$ is multiplied by its weight $w_i$,
and the products are added.

:::
